meta_description: Manage tours, tourists, and excursions for tourist group leaders.
pwa_install_text: Use it like a regular app and access your data even without internet.
pwa_ios_hint: Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
pwa_update_text: Update the app to get the latest version.
dashboard_subtitle: All essential reporting data in one place.
calendar_subtitle: All past and future tours and excursions in one monthly calendar.
calendar_no_events: There are no events on this day.
upcoming_tours_subtitle: Upcoming trips that need your attention.
no_upcoming_tours: There are no planned tours yet.
reporting_help_text: Fill the directories first, then combine the required records in a tour.
tours_subtitle: Create trips and assign tourists and excursions to them.
tourists_subtitle: Contact and document details of tourist group participants.
excursions_subtitle: Programme, time, place, and responsible guide for each excursion.
detail_no_related_tours: This record is not part of any tour yet.
detail_no_tourists: No tourists assigned to this tour yet.
detail_no_excursions: No excursions assigned to this tour yet.
not_found_text: It may have been deleted, or the link is out of date.
confirm_delete_tourist: Delete the tourist “{name}”? They will be removed from every tour.
confirm_delete_excursion: Delete the excursion “{name}”? It will be removed from every tour.
search_global_hint: Type a tour name, tourist name, place, guide, or contact — the search covers every section at once.
search_tourists: Search by name, phone, or email
search_excursions: Search by title, place, or guide
empty_tours_text: Add a destination, dates, tourists, and excursions — everything required for a future report.
empty_tourists_text: Add group participants so that you can quickly assign them to tours.
empty_excursions_text: Create excursions with a date, time, location, and guide information.
no_tourists_to_assign: Add tourists in the corresponding section first.
no_excursions_to_assign: Add excursions in the corresponding section first.
payments_empty: Nobody is enrolled in this excursion yet. Add it to a tour that has tourists.
receipts_hint: Take a photo of the receipt or pick one from the gallery. Files stay on this device only.
receipts_error_type: Only image files can be attached.
receipts_error_save: The photo could not be saved. Please try again.
